messages:
tess: Quick ask for launch day creative 1: we want an interactive slide/asset set for the webinar deck that can also be broken into static social tiles. Needs: 16:9 interactive slide (embeds a demo iframe placeholder), 3 social microtiles (cost / latency / throughput), animated SVG micro-interactions (reduced-motion variant), and A/B headline text variants for live experimentation. Can design scope this and give a first pass by Fri?
rory: Confirming: interactive slide = Figma prototype + a PNG fallback. For the iframe placeholder, do you want a mock-up frame or a linked embed snippet?
tess: Mock-up frame only (we'll swap with prod embed later). Include a ‘live demo’ CTA state. Also need to surface which assets map to A/B groups for tracking.
celeste: For A/B we need two headline variants and two subheads. We'll run benchA vs benchB in paid social. Please include short keys on the art (e.g., AB:H1A, AB:H1B) so ops can map to UTM params.
tess: exact UTM pattern we want: `?utm_source=webinar&utm_campaign=bench_launch&utm_content=H1A` and `H1B` for the other variant. Add example in asset manifest.
analytics-bot: Note for ops: Amplitude event = `webinar.reg_submit` with property `creative_variant` (values: bench_H1A, bench_H1B). CRM tag: `source=webinar_benchA` or `webinar_benchB`.
rory: design questions: 1) should the microtiles include data labels or be 'sparklines only'? 2) color schema for reduced motion / dark theme?
tess: Microtiles: sparklines + one bold callout number (p50 latency / cost per 1k). Keep data labels optional as a plane in Figma comments. Use token palette; provide dark theme. Reduced-motion: provide static PNGs and a second SVG set marked `reduced_motion` that avoids transforms.
design-bot: Created file 'Interactive Launch / Demo + Tiles' and branch 'interactive-4447778888' 1: https://www.figma.com/file/launch-interactive/interactive-4447778888
celeste: legal/brand constraints: no absolutes like "fastest"; use "low-latency" / "cost-efficient". Brand font: Redwood Sans. Logomark min 72px. Contrast 4.5:1. Provide alt-text for every export.
analytics-bot: Also make a small JSON snippet example for ops to wire into the registration form, e.g.:
```
{ "event":"webinar.reg_submit", "properties": { "creative_variant":"bench_H1A", "utm_campaign":"bench_launch" }}
```
Include this snippet in the one-pager.
rory: Good, I'll include the snippet as copy in the design file. Export plan: 16:9 prototype + PNG fallback 1920x1080, social tiles 1200x628 + 800x800, thumbnail 600x360, SVG icons, and reduced-motion SVGs. Naming convention: `launch_interactive_v1_{variant}_{w}x{h}.png`.
tess: Also need an asset manifest CSV for content ops with columns: filename, width, height, variant_key, alt_text, copy_key, legal_note. We'll need to stage EN + ES copy variants.
celeste: I'll provide translations for headlines/subheads. Keep headline <= 60 chars. Subhead <= 140 chars. CTA <= 20 chars.
brand-ops: When branch is ready tag @brand-ops for review. We'll check contrast and logo sizing. Also require a microcopy footnote frame that states: "Test conditions: internal devbench, representative results."
rory: Will push a first pass to the branch with components, prototype frames, and an 'exports' page. ETA Thu evening for frames, Fri morning for full exports + JSON manifest.
tess: Awesome. One more: include a short speaker cue frame that explains the slide behavior (what to click to show the demo state and how to toggle A/B). That helps ops and presenters.
design-bot: Export presets added to branch 'interactive-4447778888' 1: PNG 1920x1080, 1200x628, 800x800, 600x360; SVG icons; GIF not required.
tess: Thanks team 1 flag any blockers here and I'll schedule the brand/legal handoff once we have first pass. :rocket:
